ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_oven.title: Baking in Bulk
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_oven.desc: Build a &6Mega Oven&r: a whole guh bakery of 3 by 2 by 2 on vadskracht. Click with an empty hand to choose what it bakes.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_station.title: Weather for the Whole Base
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_station.desc: Put a &bNibble Weather Station&r next to your Weather Vadser and feed it nibbles: then the weather covers your whole base.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_koepel.title: A Sky Full of Guhs
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_koepel.desc: Build the &dStar Dome&r and feed it nibbles until the first guh constellation lights up.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_molen.title: A Fair for Guhs
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_molen.desc: Build a &dMerry-Go-Round&r and buy a ticket (a cheese nibble): your guhs ride along and get happy.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_vanger.title: Catching Clouds
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.koepel_vanger.desc: Put a &bCloud Catcher&r on the roof: the higher, the more fluff.
